title: Anima Mundi
description:
You have an especially close connection with the elemental spirits of the world—the roots, rocks, winds, waters, and more—and they see you as a guardian, caretaker, and ambassador. You can **Cast a Spell** by entreating natural spirits for aid. When you do so, your unique ✷7-9 option is:

- The spirits demand a favor or sacrifice; the GM will say more after you choose this.

outcomes.text: Each time you **Cast a Spell** this way, answer the questions below.  Your Casting Stat for the spell starts at 0 and increases by 1 for each "Yes".
bullets: Are you wielding and wearing no metal whatsoever?
Does this leverage a nearby natural feature or entity?
Will this restore harmony or advance a cycle of nature?

title: Back to Basics
description: When you **reveal a new flaw or failure of civilization to one or more NPCs**, clear a Condition, then roll+CHA

bullets: They account for the issue and start working to fix it
They attack or sabotage an enemy of nature
They protect you or nature from an imminent threat

outcomes.text: You draw an enemy's attention; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Commune with Nature
description: When you **spend time connected with natural spirits**, ask one question below about the region you're in, or ask all of them but mark a Condition after hearing the answers. The GM will answer honestly

bullets: Does anything here threaten the natural world?
What danger or enemy here should we be aware of?
What person or location here could be helpful to us?

title: Death and Regrowth
description: When you **finish off a significant enemy**, or when you **suffer max DMG**, gain 1 Lifeforce (max 2). You can spend Lifeforce as if it was a use of **medicine**.

title: Eye of the Storm
description: When you **Cast a Spell** by entreating natural spirits for aid, if all three questions are answered "Yes", you can treat the **MAG** as if it were 1 lower when comparing it to your **Casting Stat**
